by
  let C := 2 * (sup_norm f)
  use C
  intros τ
  cases UpperHalfPlane.isBoundedAtImInfty hf_infinity τ with C' hC'
  have hC : ‖f τ‖ ≤ C' := hC'
  refine le_trans (le_trans hC _) _
  exact le_rfl
  refine le_trans _ (le_mul_right (le_of_lt (lt_top_iff.1 (le_one))))
  exact le_sup_norm f τ
